description: This file contains utility functions for Triton code generation within PyTorch's Inductor backend, including signature handling, buffer alignment checks, and argument analysis specific to Triton kernels.

methods.name: should_unwrap_unspec_arg
methods.description: Determines if an argument should be unwrapped based on device and usage.

methods.name: signature_of
methods.description: Generates a signature string for a given kernel argument based on its type and context.

methods.name: non_constexpr_signature
methods.description: Filters out ConstexprArg from a signature list.

methods.name: signature_to_meta
methods.description: Converts a signature list into a metadata dictionary with argument names and types.

methods.name: is_unaligned_buffer
methods.description: Checks if a tensor buffer is unaligned based on layout and buffer info.

methods.name: _arg_equals_1
methods.description: Checks if a SizeArg has a statically known value of 1.

methods.name: equal_1_arg_indices
methods.description: Returns indices of arguments that are SizeArgs equal to 1.

methods.name: config_of
methods.description: Determines configuration attributes (like alignment) for a list of kernel arguments.
